vnc_enabled.label: Remote screen control (VNC)
vnc_enabled.description: Enables "Take screen control" on the agent page (requires UltraVNC installed on the managed machine).

process_monitor_enabled.label: Suspicious process killing
process_monitor_enabled.description: Global switch for automatically killing watchlist processes (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, etc.) on all agents. Detection still runs (visible on "Suspicious Processes") while this is off - nothing gets killed, as if every agent were temporarily whitelisted. On by default so an app upgrade doesn't silently disable existing protection.
